title: Printable area units sheet (lesson 62)
subject: Mathematics
source: Seeded from mathematics/y8 lesson 62 (Printable area units sheet (portal worksheet for this lesson))
intro: Lesson 62: Area problems: units and missing lengths. To understand how to convert between units of area and solve area problems with mixed units and missing lengths

model.title: A floor is 4.5 m by 3.2 m. Tiles are 30 cm by 30 cm. How many tiles are needed, ignoring cutting?
A parallelogram has area 3.6 m² and base 240 cm. Find its height in cm.

questions.q: A triangle has area 1.2 m² and base 1.5 m. Find its height.
(a) 7 m² in cm² (b) 2500 cm² in m² (c) 6 cm² in mm² (d) a rectangular rug of area 6 m² is 250 cm wide: how long is it in m? (e) a wall 5 m by 2.4 m is painted and one tin covers 8 m²: how many tins?
questions.a: (a) 70 000 cm² (b) 0.25 m² (c) 600 mm² (d) 2.4 m (e) 12 m² needs 1.5 tins, so buy 2

questions.q: A prayer hall floor is 18 m by 12 m. Each person praying needs about 1.2 m by 0.5 m. Roughly how many can pray at once?
A rectangular field of 3.5 hectares is 250 m long. How wide is it?
Big question: why is 1 m² not 100 cm²?
questions.a: 1 m² is 100 cm by 100 cm, which holds 100 × 100 = 10 000 squares of 1 cm².
